subject: 1093年大理国马厩（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: Dali gray-tile timber stable for an isometric city map. Preserve original open stalls, troughs, straw, timber columns, pale side wall, gray tile roof, realistic materials and upper-left lighting. Change the stable's plan from very narrow and elongated to a WIDER-DEPTH 8x6 rectangle (front facade width / side depth = 1.333). Camera ORTHOGRAPHIC exactly 45-degree yaw, 30-degree elevation, 2:1 ground projection. Both ground axes slope equally, +0.5 and -0.5 (not generic 30 degree isometric). Shorten the long facade and enlarge right side depth. On 1536x1024 canvas thin ground patch contact corners LEFT(152,540), FRONT(856,892), RIGHT(1384,628), BACK(680,276). Front stalls face screen lower-left. Ground front corner should be slightly right of center. Floor geometry exactly matches vectors(+704,+352) and(+528,-264). Roof ridge and eaves and all architectural horizontal edges follow these same two axes. Keep THREE wide stalls, no horses or people. Clean thin rectangular earth/stone footprint, not pedestal. True transparent RGBA background and opaque stable, generous transparent margins, all tips visible, no external terrain, text, logos, modern elements, watermark or guide/grid lines. ONE sprite.
